subject.title: [Bug]: Install bug:No matching version found for node-domexception@1.0.28

question: Should the remaining node-domexception install fix be repaired through the open external PR or replaced by a maintainer-owned dependency update?
rationale: The open candidate changes root dependency resolution and the obvious 2.0.2 target has compatibility and dependency-graph approval concerns that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Carry a maintainer-owned dependency update
options.body: A maintainer selects the compatible resolver target, regenerates all package-manager artifacts, and lands the reviewed dependency graph with install/build proof.

options.title: Repair the open linked PR
options.body: Keep https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95960 as the landing vehicle if its dependency target, conflicts, artifacts, and authorization can be fixed.

options.title: Keep researching the resolver contract
options.body: Leave this issue open while maintainers compare 1.x, alias, and transitive dependency alternatives before choosing a patch.

recommendation.title: Carry a maintainer-owned dependency update
recommendation.body: A maintainer selects the compatible resolver target, regenerates all package-manager artifacts, and lands the reviewed dependency graph with install/build proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior merged work introduced and later reshaped the exact alias and package-manager guardrails involved in the failure.
